messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — reserved-gpu-node gpu-23 in cluster cedar-reserved-1 reported thermal trip + ECC spike. Multiple 5xxs observed for CedarHealth VPC (tenant cedarhealth). Auto-eviction kicked, node marked UNHEALTHY. Creating thread for live coord.

taylor: ACK, I'm oncall. Paging SRE. Starting triage. Can someone confirm customer-facing impact and request a point of contact from CedarHealth?

ajay: on it — checking node telemetry now. nvidia-smi shows repeated ECC errors, GPU clock downscaling and fans at 100%. Likely hardware thermal/VRM issue, could be BMC-triggered shutdown.

maria: CedarHealth team on Slack is on standby (I DMed their SRE). They report increased latency and a few request failures for model-inference jobs — mostly long-seq inferences. No data exfil concerns.

frank: Recommend immediate mitigation: isolate node, migrate CedarHealth active workers to reserved-fallback-pool-2, and scale that pool to handle burst. Also enable KV-prefix cache warmup on fallback to avoid cold penalty.

taylor: Agreed. Plan: 1) cordon node gpu-23 2) evict tenants with graceful drain window 30s 3) kick off tenant migration to pool-fallback-2 4) mark node for hardware replace and RMA. I'll run the commands and post progress.

(taylor runs)
```
# cordon
rictl node cordon cedar-reserved-1/gpu-23 --reason thermal-trip
# migrate tenant
rictl tenant migrate cedarhealth --from-pool cedar-reserved-1 --to-pool reserved-fallback-pool-2 --priority high --grace-period 30s
# verify
rictl tenant status cedarhealth --watch
```

ajay: Started eviction. Observed two stuck worker processes; forcing eviction for those (SIGKILL) to free KV cache. Pushing to fallback pool now.

maria: CedarHealth SRE confirms they see new hosts accepting requests. Latency on fallback is ~120ms higher per token but throughput stable. They asked about request ordering guarantees during migration — replied we'll preserve session affinity for active keys.

natalie: Monitoring note — fallback pool has lower GPU memory per card (quantized model variant). Watch for regressed outputs; enabling realtime eval hooks for CedarHealth prompt set. Will alert if quality drops >1.5% on eval metrics.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0452 created and P1 declared. Linking runbook: /runbooks/reserved-pool-hardware. Auto-page sent to infra-hardware team.

frank: I'm opening a hardware case with vendor (ticket VND-987654). Including serials and ECC logs: attached nvram dump + `dmesg` snippet: 
```
[ 1234.567891] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 1234.568003] nvidia 0000:65:00.0: GPU reported ECC error: device memory
[ 1234.570120] kernel: thermal_zone0: critical temp reached
```

ajay: Vendor prelim diagnosis says VRM/board-level thermal failure, RMA advised. ETA for replacement node provisioning ~45-60 minutes if we failover workload to spare hardware.

taylor: Handoff note — I'm at 23:58 PST and shift ends in 12m. @ajay take primary; I'll stay reachable for customer comms until you confirm migration complete. Summary pinned below.

ajay: Taking lead. Current status: migration in progress, 6/8 CedarHealth workers active on pool-fallback-2, 2 finishing eviction. KV warmup running. No customer-facing errors from CedarHealth reported in last 90s.

maria: CedarHealth wants a short RCA and whether we can guarantee no more evictions this week. Advised RMA + replacement node + post-replace soak. They've accepted temporary increase in reserved capacity on fallback pool until replacement is live.

natalie: Telemetry update: token error rate for cedarhealth dropped from 4.3% -> 0.6% since migration began. Tail latency still elevated; added autoscale run to increase replica count to reduce queuing.

jen: Noting followups for postmortem: - why thermal spike not predicted by gradual trend alerts - improve preemptive eviction policy (evict before 5xx spike) - add quick-rollback to pin customer to standby pool during hardware incidents. Assigning owner: jen.

incident-bot: Node gpu-23 marked MAINTENANCE and removed from scheduler. Spare node allocated to reserved-fallback-pool-2 for temporary buffering.

ajay: Migration finished. All CedarHealth workers now on fallback pool. Verified 0 failing requests for last 5m. Starting RMA closure tasks and marking incident as mitigated.

taylor: Thanks team. I'll draft the initial incident summary for CedarHealth and set postmortem meeting tomorrow. Quick notes for timeline will be in the incident doc.

frank: Hardware ticket updated with RMA #RMA-33421. Replacement ETA 6 hours due to part shipping; we're provisioning spare GPUs to keep fallback capacity for next 12h.

maria: CedarHealth SRE confirmed they are satisfied with mitigation and are switching to monitoring-only. They requested status updates via email — I'll send summary.

jen: Assigning postmortem owners and checklist added to the incident: INC-2026-0452/PM.

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Closing thread in 2h unless new regressions. :white_check_mark:
